quotes.author: Relax62576686300
quotes.text: We loved our experience with these horses and staff. I don't have riding experience but they took the time to teach me patiently and match me with a horse that they thought would do well with me. My horse was a sweetheart! My family loved it also! The scenery was gorgeous and the staff took the time to take pictures of us ... see you next year!

quotes.author: Travel02846571154
quotes.text: This was a special anniversary gift for my husband, who had never been horseback riding before. We absolutely loved our experience and highly recommend it! The horses are wonderful with people and have such a great personality and the staff are very friendly, helpful and informative. Thank you for making our anniversary special!

quotes.author: Explore33766951742
quotes.text: The owner and his team are friendly and organized, and the horses are great and well looked after. Some of the horses are rescues, which makes it even more special. The ride is both fun and relaxing, and it being on one of the most amazing settings makes it just a perfectly beautiful and uplifting experience!

quotes.author: Adventure16551719112
quotes.text: The people who run the activity are highly sensitive to their guests. I took my five-year-old daughter and we rode double. I had not much experience but was made to feel safe and really enjoyed my time on the horses! I’ll definitely go again!!!!!

Virginia Beach & Outer Banks Horseback is a rental service specializing in guided beach horseback rides. We genuinely have a passion for and love horseback riding. Our ability to do this activity on the beach is something everyone in this world should experience. We strive to give our customers an adventure and memory that they will never forget.

For the ultimate horseback riding experience in Virginia Beach or the Outer Banks, look no further than our horseback riding tours with Virginia Beach & Outer Banks Horseback. This is an experience you’ll never forget as your trusty steed walks along the soft sands of the beach and the lapping waves of the ocean serenade you.
